candidates.change_summary: Replace the safe increment with an unchecked increment so overflow (wrap) is possible and deposit count may differ after receive.
Remove the require guard so depositsCount is incremented unconditionally, allowing a revert that previously prevented state change to no longer occur.
Make the require condition deliberately false to force every receive() to revert and thus prevent depositsCount from increasing.
Change the require to check a stricter condition that will revert when depositsCount would grow (require next is strictly greater), preventing increments when equal overflow edgecases occur.
Swap order: increment first then assert the non-decreasing property, allowing a transient state where require can revert after state change (causing revert and no net change) in some cases.

Replaced the call to withdraw(...) with an inline transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender (keeping onlyOwner modifier), which changes behavior if withdraw was overridden or had additional logic.
Removed the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and thus changing observable behavior.
Replace transfer with a call to send funds but ignore returned success value (uses low-level call without revert on failure).
Replace transfer with a require on send's boolean result so withdrawal reverts on failure using low-level call.
Modify onlyOwner to allow anyone (remove the require), changing access control so withdraw can be called by non-owners.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners can call functions guarded by onlyOwner, changing who can withdraw.
